name: Praeornis
isnote: Rautian (1978) thought it more primitive than Archaeopteryx; Bock (1986) took it for a cycad leaf; later work suggests a feather, possibly of an enantiornithine.
sum: Late Jurassic feather-like fossil from the Karabastau Formation of Kazakhstan, probably the feather of an early avialan.
holotype: PIN 2585/32, a single feather from the Karabastau Formation, Aulie, Kazakhstan, collected by Sharov and named by Rautian (1978).
material: The holotype and a second specimen, ZPAL V 32/967, described by Dzik et al. (2010).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Rautian 1978

sources.text: E. N. Kurochkin. 2000. Mesozoic birds of Mongolia and the former USSR. The Age of Dinosaurs in Russia and Mongolia
